diagnostic_reason: the size arm is read here and not scored: the nearest size class named in rule text, the FDIC's $10 billion line between small and large institutions, coincides with the top band's lower edge, but its two rate schedules overlap and it names the fed funds position only on its large side, while the step that reads lies inside its small class; the one class rule text names on the lending side of this position, the banker's bank of 12 CFR 327.5(b), writes its term on its own assessment base, where it can lower and cannot raise what the class's borrowers pay, while the smaller filers pay more; no grid is assigned to any reading in this record
